No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you examine Buddhist monastic living, water and rock-cut architecture.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Transport/park gate orientation
  • Selected accessible caves
  • Rock-cut cistern and vihara observation
  • Return and evidence recap

How the time is spent

  1. Transport/park gate orientation 30 min

  2. Selected accessible caves 60 min

  3. Rock-cut cistern and vihara observation 65 min

  4. Return and evidence recap 25 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe how the selected caves at Kanheri served Buddhist monastic living.
  • Identify rock-cut cisterns and viharas and explain what they show about water and monastic life.
  • Summarise the evidence for rock-cut architecture seen across the caves.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
